notes: Account summary: LucentWell is a mid-size EHR integrator serving regional hospital networks and specialty clinics. Heavy PHI surface area; wants to add a fast RAG layer for clinician search and decision support.
Primary ask: embeddings + reranking pipeline to power 'Find relevant note / guideline' inside clinician workflow. Target is high recall with deterministic reranking for provenance.
Indexing scale: currently ~30M clinical notes + 12M structured observations across 6 hospitals. Expect growth 30%/yr. POC limited to 3 hospitals (~6M docs).
Latency / throughput: 95th pctile <200ms for single-query clinician lookups; sustained load 300 qps during shift peaks; bursts to 1k qps acceptable with soft degradation.
Cost targets: target cost per user query (end-to-end) <$0.02; looking for batching + dense vector storage savings. Wants breakdown by token cost vs embedding/rerank compute.

Model preferences: open LLM variants preferred for auditability. Considering local quantized rerank model on dedicated GPUs + hosted for lightweight embedding generation. Must support pinned model versions.

Security & compliance notes: BAA mandatory, logs for every token-level access, audit trail of prompt+response for each PHI access, retention/erase controls for vectors, KMS integration required, SSO via SAML + SCIM provisioning.
Networking: cannot route PHI through multi-tenant public endpoints. Must support VPC peering, private endpoints, or on-prem appliance. Egress restrictions to allow only approved model repos.

POC plan: 6-week POC. Week 1 ingest + small index (6M docs). Week 2-3: embeddings + vector store + baseline recall. Week 4: integrate reranker, latency tuning. Week 5: cost modeling and optimize (batching/quantization). Week 6: security review and handoff.
